title: Cognoscenti: A Benchmark for Trustworthy AI Memory
description:
Cognoscenti is a benchmark for cognitive and emergent memory systems. The 2026-08-02 public run compares RAG, agent-memory, and organic-memory reference baselines on activation, selective forgetting, interference resistance, contextual recall, consolidation, adaptation, and efficiency.

Public benchmark report: https://achiral.ai/benchmarks/ai-memory-benchmark
Figshare preprint and reproducibility bundle: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33288195
